tap.text: A single soft, friendly UI button tap: a short rounded wooden 'tock', dry, no reverb

key.text: A single tiny soft keyboard click, light and bubbly, very short, dry

nav.text: A gentle two-note rising marimba blip for a menu selection, short and dry

correct.text: A bright cheerful 'correct answer' chime for a children's game: three quick rising glockenspiel notes with a sparkle

combo.text: An excited rising run of five sparkling glockenspiel notes ending in a magical twinkle, children's game combo reward

wrong.text: A gentle, kind 'try again' sound for a children's game: two soft low wooden marimba notes going down, not harsh, not a buzzer

pop.text: A single satisfying cartoon bubble pop, juicy and bright, dry

star.text: A single bright magical star ding with a short shimmer, children's game collectable

crystal.text: A magical crystal being collected: shimmering glassy chimes swelling into a bright sparkling chord, wondrous and warm

jump.text: A cute cartoon jump 'boing' whoosh rising in pitch, soft and playful, short

swim.text: A quick underwater swoosh with a few bubbles, like a friendly sea creature darting forward

whoosh.text: A soft airy magical whoosh passing by, light and quick

crack.text: A large egg shell cracking open in three quick crunchy cracks, cartoon style

chirp.text: A tiny baby dragon giving two happy squeaky chirps, adorable cartoon creature

portal.text: A magical portal opening: a rising shimmering swirl of sparkles and soft synth, friendly and wondrous

guardian.text: A big goofy cartoon creature going 'bwomp' with a silly wobbly low tuba note, funny not scary

plank.text: A single wooden plank dropping snugly into place with a solid friendly 'clonk'

unlock.text: A treasure being unlocked: a small click followed by a warm rising harp flourish and sparkle

friendship.text: A joyful magical power-up for a children's game: a rising harp glissando and sparkling chimes bursting into a bright triumphant rainbow chord

levelComplete.text: A short happy level-complete fanfare for a children's game played on xylophone, glockenspiel and a soft brass section, ending on a bright chord

victory.text: A triumphant, joyful victory fanfare for a children's adventure game with bright brass, bells and a cymbal swell, ending on a big happy chord

roar_maia.text: A big flustered mother duck-billed dinosaur giving a loud honking call, like a giant goose crossed with a tuba, comical and cartoonish for a children's game, not scary

roar_trevor.text: A grumpy cartoon triceratops snorting hard through its nose then giving a short low bellowing grumble, chunky and comical for a children's game, not scary

roar_rex.text: A huge cartoon Tyrannosaurus rex roar for a children's game: big, deep and impressive with a rumbling growl, rounded and theatrical rather than horrifying, no screaming, ending in a grumpy huff

stomp.text: Three heavy cartoon dinosaur footsteps thudding on the ground, deep booms with a little rattle of pebbles, playful

machine_whirr.text: A rickety home-made time machine starting up: clockwork ticking speeding up, a propeller whirring, springs boinging and a magical rising shimmer, cartoonish and fun

machine_crash.text: A cartoon crash landing: a falling whoosh, a big clanging thud of a metal bathtub hitting the ground, then springs, cogs and bolts bouncing and scattering with comic boings and one last bell ding

snore.text: A big cartoon dinosaur snoring peacefully: a deep rumbling snore in, then a whistling breath out, comical and gentle, for a children's game

splash.text: A small cartoon stone plopping into a stream with a gentle splash and a bubbly gurgle, light and playful

ratchet.text: A quick cartoon spanner tightening a bolt: three crisp metallic ratchet clicks ending in a satisfying clunk

tiptoe.text: Two soft careful cartoon tiptoe footsteps on leaves, light and sneaky, very quiet

roar_steggy.text: A dramatic cartoon stegosaurus giving a theatrical, offended trumpeting bellow with a whirring propeller spinning, comical and cartoonish for a children's game, not scary

roar_swoop.text: Three cheeky cartoon pterosaurs squawking excitedly together with a whoosh of flapping wings as they swoop past, comical for a children's game, not scary

roar_raptors.text: A pack of small fluffy cartoon raptors giving quick excited clucking chirps and cheeky giggly squawks, like angry chickens, comical for a children's game, not scary

stomp_big.text: One single enormous cartoon dinosaur stomp: a deep, punchy boom of a giant foot hitting the ground, with a short rumble and a rattle of pebbles, fun and powerful, not scary
